resources.string: Already using Rún on another phone? Move it here and your contacts, groups and conversations come with you.
Rún packs everything into one sealed transfer and shows you a code. Scan that code on the new phone while you set it up.
Your contacts, your groups, and the keys your conversations run on.
Your recovery code, %1$s protection, and notifications. Set those up again on the new phone.
This phone stops sending and receiving the moment you start, and stays that way until you wipe it or cancel the move.
Scan this on the new phone
On the new phone, open Rún, choose “Move from another phone”, and scan this code.
Anyone who photographs this code can take the transfer. Show it only to the new phone.
Copy this into the new phone if the camera will not cooperate.
The transfer waits on the relay for 30 minutes. After that, show the code again.
Too late to cancel — the transfer has already been picked up.
Could not check whether the new phone has the transfer yet. Try again in a moment, or wipe this phone once the new one is working.
Check the new phone first: it should show your contacts. Once it does, wiping this phone is what makes the move safe — nothing here can be read afterwards.
If the new phone never got it, the code may simply have run out. Keep this phone off and show a fresh code instead.
Rún no longer sends or receives here. Wipe it whenever you are ready.
A move was started here, so Rún no longer sends or receives on this phone. Show a fresh code to finish the move, cancel to use this phone again, or wipe it.
Could not reach the relay. Check your connection and try again.
Could not prepare the transfer. Try again.
The transfer did not upload. Try again.
There is too much here to move in one transfer.
The vault is not open. Unlock and try again.
The move did not work. Try again.
On the old phone, open the settings menu, tap “Move to new device”, and scan the code it shows.
That is not a Rún transfer code.
Keep Rún open — this runs over Tor and takes a moment.
The transfer is no longer on the relay. Show the code again on the old phone.
That code did not open the transfer. Show the code again on the old phone.
The transfer could not be read. Show the code again on the old phone.
The old phone runs a newer Rún. Update Rún here, then try again.
Could not finish bringing your data over. Try again.
This phone has already taken over a move.
